text: The chilled water plant shall be N+1: three air-cooled screw chillers of 50 % duty each (3 x 50 %; two chillers in duty and one standby, 480 kW cooling each at 7/13 degC per the equipment records), two chilled water pumps 2 x 100 % and the associated valves and controls arranged so that the loss of any one chiller, pump or power feeder does not reduce the cooling of the electrical and control rooms; the chillers shall be supplied from different MCC sections (both sections of the essential distribution).
